gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that getSummary() returns a StatisticalSummary snapshot that stays in sync with the parent SummaryStatistics as values are added.
ADDED i2: Asserts that every statistical field in the snapshot equals the corresponding field on the live accumulator.
ADDED i3: Verifies that getSummary() reflects the current state of the accumulator both on an empty instance and after each successive addValue() call.
ADDED i4: Empty accumulator: snapshot should show zeros/NaNs consistent with the live state.
ADDED i5: After each addValue the snapshot must mirror the updated accumulator.
